model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата е кръгова диаграма, сравняваща различни категории персонажи, както е представено от техните ключови области. Включени са 12 сектора, всеки от които е обозначен с различна категория: Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Custom Characters, Scientists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, Influencers, Novel Characters, Game Characters и Teleplay Characters. Секторите са оцветени в различни нюанси на синьо, зелено, червено и жълто. Определянето на точните проценти за всеки сектор е трудно без допълнителна информация, но визуално се наблюдава спад в размера на сектора от синьо до жълто. Диаграмата не включва легенда или етикети с проценти вътре в секторите, а никой от секторите не е визуално подчертан.
model_annotations.English: This pie chart illustrates a comparison of various character types. The chart comprises a total of fifteen slices, each representing a distinct category. These categories include Comic Characters (in pink), Movie Characters (in light blue), Custom Characters (in green), Virtual Characters (in a lighter blue), Teleplay Characters (in dark blue), Novel Characters (in a slightly darker blue), Game Characters (in purple), Scientists (in light green), Athletes (in dark green), Writers (in medium green), Musicians (in a brighter green), Actors (in a yellow-green), Influencers (in a gray-green), Real Characters (in a pale green), and Artists (in a muted pink). Percentage labels are not present within the slices. The segments appear ordered roughly in descending size from left to right; however, due to the circular arrangement determining a definitive order is difficult. A legend is provided above the chart, listing the labels for each category.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Kreisdiagramm vergleicht verschiedene Kategorien von Charakteren. Es zeigt insgesamt 11 Segmente unterschiedlicher Farben: Comic Characters (lila), Movie Characters (hellblau), Custom Characters (grün), Scientists (hellgrün), Athletes (pink), Writers (hellrosa), Musicians (gelb), Actors (orange), Influencers (hellorange), Novel Characters (blau) und Game Characters (cyan).  Die Segmente sind nach Größe angeordnet, wobei Comic Characters in der Mitte liegen und Novel Characters den größten äußeren Abschnitt bilden.  Das Diagramm enthält eine Legende.
